name: System Closure Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for system inactivity.

BHOL.name: Banking Holiday
BHOL.definition: System is closed due to a bank holiday.

SMTN.name: System Maintenance
SMTN.definition: System is closed for maintenance reasons.

NOOP.name: No Operation
NOOP.definition: System is not processing any operation.

RCVR.name: Recovery
RCVR.definition: System is not operational during recovery operations.

ADTW.name: Allowed Downtime Window
ADTW.definition: System is not operational during allowed downtime windows.
